question.text: For a real number <math><mi>α</mi><mo>,</mo></math> if the system <math><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mtable><mtr><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd><mtd><mi>α</mi></mtd><mtd><msup><mrow><mi>α</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi>α</mi></mtd><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd><mtd><mi>α</mi></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><msup><mrow><mi>α</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mtd><mtd><mi>α</mi></mtd><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></mrow></mfenced><mi> </mi><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mtable><mtr><mtd><mi>x</mi></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi>y</mi></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi>z</mi></mtd></mtr></mtable></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mtable><mtr><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mn>1</mn></mtd></mtr></mtable></mrow></mfenced></math> of linear equations, has infinitely many solutions, then <math><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>α</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>α</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mi> </mi></math>

solution.text:
Determinant value of 3× 3 matrix should be zero for infinite solution

Δ=0 ⇒   11-α2-αα-α3+α2α2-α2=0

1-α2-α2+α4=0

α2-12=0  ⇒   α= ± 1

But at  α=1, three equations become parallel, so no solution so rejected

at   α=-1, All three equation become

x-y+z=1  (coincident planes), so infinite solution.

∴     1+α+α2=1
